title: The Dragon's Shed Skin
text: A dragon has shed its skin in the valley, a husk as big as a hall, split down the back where it climbed free. Its scales hang loose and shining in the wind. It still holds the dragon's warmth and smell, along with something of its rage.

options.label: Gather the loose scales, and mind their edges.

outcomes.text: There is wyrmbone and scale enough to armour a House. Their edges bite the hands that gather them.

options.label: The toughest climbs inside the skin and wears it, to borrow the dragon's dread.

outcomes.text: For a week they smell like dragon. Things in the wild give them a very wide berth.

options.label: Burn it, so that no rival can have it.

outcomes.text: It burns for a day, its smoke heavy with rage. Somewhere, a dragon lifts its head.
